rollback.disable: Disable only admitted consumers through reviewed configuration.
rollback.revoke: Revoke exact grants and binding through qualified owner lane.
rollback.retain: Retain all pending custody, receipts and audit history.
rollback.verify: Demonstrate revocation refusal before declaring rollback complete.

acceptance.smoke: Real human choice, native receipt, both-item atomic read-back and audit.
acceptance.forgery: Native altered-signature and wrong-origin refusal without side effects.
acceptance.replay: Native replay refusal with exactly one original ruling.
acceptance.staleAsk: Concurrent Ask revision rejects the entire batch.
acceptance.staleTarget: Concurrent linked revision rejects the entire batch.
acceptance.lostReply: Read-only recovery after an uncertain send, no automatic resend.
acceptance.revocation: Exact grant/binding revocation refuses the former writer.
